cards.vietnamese: Tàu con thoi (tàu vũ trụ có thể tái sử dụng)
cards.definition: A spacecraft designed to make repeated journeys between Earth and space.
cards.example: The astronauts flew into orbit aboard the space shuttle.

cards.vietnamese: Xe tự hành khám phá bề mặt hành tinh
cards.definition: A vehicle used for exploring the surface of an extraterrestrial body.
cards.example: The Curiosity rover landed on Mars to collect rock samples.

cards.vietnamese: Kính thiên văn (dùng quan sát các thiên thể ở xa)
cards.definition: An optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer.
cards.example: Look through the telescope to see the craters on the moon.

cards.vietnamese: Chòm sao (nhóm sao tạo thành hình vẽ trên bầu trời)
cards.definition: A group of stars forming a recognizable pattern.
cards.example: The Big Dipper is a well-known constellation in the northern sky.

cards.vietnamese: Miệng hố (trên bề mặt mặt trăng hoặc do thiên thạch va chạm)
cards.definition: A large, bowl-shaped cavity in the ground or on a planet or the moon.
cards.example: The moon has thousands of craters made by meteorite impacts.

exercises.question: A vehicle designed to drive across the surface of Mars or the Moon is called a ________.
exercises.explanation: Xe tự hành di chuyển trên bề mặt hành tinh là rover.

exercises.question: Astronomers use a ________ to observe distant planets and bright stars clearly.
exercises.explanation: Kính thiên văn dùng để ngắm các hành tinh từ xa là telescope.

exercises.question: A recognizable pattern of stars in the night sky is called a ________.
exercises.explanation: Chòm sao tạo thành hình trên bầu trời là constellation.

exercises.question: The spacecraft that took astronauts into orbit and returned like a glider is a ________.
exercises.explanation: Tàu con thoi là space shuttle.
